interface.signature: def maxCandies(self, status: List[int], candies: List[int], keys: List[List[int]], containedBoxes: List[List[int]], initialBoxes: List[int]) -> int

preconditions.description: The length of the status list must be between 1 and 1000.
The lengths of status, candies, keys, and containedBoxes must be equal.

preconditions.expression: all(s in {0, 1} for s in status)
preconditions.description: Each element in the status list must be either 0 or 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= c <= 1000 for c in candies)
preconditions.description: Each element in the candies list must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= len(k) <= len(status) for k in keys)
preconditions.description: The length of each keys list must be between 0 and the length of status.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= len(cb) <= len(status) for cb in containedBoxes)
preconditions.description: The length of each containedBoxes list must be between 0 and the length of status.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= b < len(status) for b in initialBoxes)
preconditions.description: Each element in the initialBoxes list must be a valid index of the status list.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(candies[i] for i in range(len(status)) if status[i] == 1 or i in opened_boxes)
postconditions.description: The return value must be the total number of candies collected from all open boxes.
